summary: Main road kerb at a pedestrian crossing with no parked cars and a house 9 m away.
reasons: Through road, no parking on this kerb

best_section.where: East kerb of Clarence Road just past the pedestrian crossing

drivers.seclusion: Sports fields across the road, but a house sits 9 m from the north end and apartments 18 m from the south end.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs beside a marked crossing and traffic islands; no visible bay or verge to pull fully off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road linking suburbs, with marked lanes and a crossing.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb; the few parked cars are on the opposite side.

flags: Main road with no parked cars on this kerb
sun_shade: Mostly open; tree canopy shades the south end.
